page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number at top right; below the text a signature-like mark "c" and "lup-" at the foot of the verse. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: nis, aut (vt alij perhibent) Praxonidæ F. ab Hercule prognati, Eleus domo, ac Cleosthenes Cleonici F. Pitæus, vt populum ad concordiam pacemq; reducerét, cùm Olympicam festiuitatem statuerút ad pristinam formam redigere, tum certamen gymnicum edere. Iraq; Delphos miserunt qui Deum percontarentur, an hoc eorum probet consilium. Is respondit, bona euentura, si id exequantur: iusfitq; ferias indici vrbibus, quæ certaminis esse vellent participes. quo oraculo in Græcia renunciato, discus etiam conscriptus est à Græcorum iudicibus, quos ipsi Hellanodicas vocant, formam agendorum Olympiorum indicans. Cæterum Peloponesios nó admodum id certamé gratum habentes, molesteq; id ferentes, pestis inuasit, frugumque pernicies afflixit. Iraque ij qui antè à societate istorum ludorum defciuerant, denuò Lycurgum pestis amolitionem ac remedium poposcerunt. Pythia verò sic respondit:

l.i: O' qui telluris famosam totius arcem
Incolitis, quæ fata D E I cano discite iussu.
Neglecta altitonans irascitur ob sacra vobis

page.notes: Faint show-through and stains in the lower half; the verse lines are italic. The word "lup-" at the foot is a catchword-like hyphenated word continued on the next page. Some words are obscured by a smudge near "Delphos" and "Pythia".
